name: Tomahawk Manufacturing Inc
old_description: Since 1992, Tomahawk Manufacturing, Inc.®  has been providing the food processing industry with top quality products and services. We thank you for your patronage and look forward to serving you for many more years to come.
about:
Tomahawk Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1992 in Plymouth, Wisconsin, with a mission to provide the food processing industry an alternative source for spare parts, tooling, and equipment at competitive rates while upholding high standards of ethics and integrity. The company remains privately held and operates today with the same founding vision.

The company designs and builds a line of food forming machines — the TM-26, TM-19, TM-400, and TM-6 — capable of throughputs from 1,200 to 6,000 pounds per hour at up to 100 strokes per minute. In addition to equipment manufacturing, Tomahawk offers customized in-house tooling, spare parts supply, field service, engineering support, and operator training programs. Its operations span a corporate headquarters and manufacturing facility in Plymouth, an engineering office in Hartland, Wisconsin, an automation integration site in Albany, Georgia (Industrial Control Associates), and a European subsidiary in Rijswijk, Netherlands.

Tomahawk serves food processors across beef, poultry, seafood, pork, plant-based protein, pet food, and pet pharmaceutical segments. Its global customer base extends throughout North and South America, Europe, and Asia, supported by a network of regional agents.

The company emphasizes a responsive, customer-first approach, including 24/7 emergency assistance, on-site service, and tooling audits, aiming to minimize downtime and maintain a personal connection with each client.
